items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: So he was trying to — I says, “it’s not necessary — it’s your date, that’s the most important thing.”

ctx.x: And the Judge says, “Jackie I got to apologize,” he says, “I didn’t see your name on that thing so I don’t want you to think it was—” I says, “Well Judge, don’t worry about it, I’m

on there.” So he was trying to — I says, “it’s not necessary — it’s your date, that’s the most important thing.” Now everybody else is around you, you know. But he’s just like that you know. He wants to make everybody happy all the time.
Can you quickly name a couple of the major influences on you, the drummers you listened to on the way up?
